import sys

def main():
    n, k, l, r, sall, sk = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
    
    scores = [l] * n
    remaining_sum = sall - n * l
    top_remaining_sum = sk - k * l
    
    for i in range(k):
        add = min(r - l, top_remaining_sum)
        scores[i] += add
        top_remaining_sum -= add
        remaining_sum -= add
    
    for i in range(k, n):
        add = min(r - l, remaining_sum)
        scores[i] += add
        remaining_sum -= add
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, scores)))

main()
